serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: ProjectTeam for Government (Construction Project and Program Management)
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
ProjectTeam for Government (ProjectTeam) is a fully cloud-based construction management platform tailored specifically for public agencies managing capital construction programs and projects. ProjectTeam is a centralized, easy-to-use platform that fosters seamless collaboration among all stakeholders, including owners, contractors, architects, subcontractors, and suppliers.

The platform includes all key industry-standard processes, such as design development, budgets, contracts, change orders, payment applications, RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, turnover documents, and more. ProjectTeam offers powerful built-in, no-code customization tools that allow administrators to easily create custom forms, modify existing templates, and design workflows tailored to their agency's unique processes and project needs. This flexibility ensures that mission-critical requirements are accurately tracked, empowering organizations to streamline operations, ensure compliance, and achieve their objectives with confidence and precision.

 ProjectTeam includes:

• Visual workflow management

• No-code custom form builder

• Construction management tools

• Real-time collaboration for project stakeholders

• Document management and tracking
